ocrPassesPerCase: 1 primary pass plus 0-2 recovery passes, decided by the unchanged recovery triggers; not fixed in advance and recorded as observed
repeatPurpose: To determine whether the complete evidence package is stable. It is NOT a second sample from which the more favourable output may be chosen.
recordedPerRun: package-lock resolved versions for tesseract.js and tesseract.js-core
prohibited: changing any configuration between primary and repeat
